description: Possible topics include: Bayesian statistics, bioinformatics, biostatistics, clustering methods, longitudinal data analysis, mixture models, robust statistics, spatial statistics, sampling theory and methods, statistics for imaging, and statistical computing. Information on the topics available in any given year may be obtained from the department.
repeatableCatalogText: May be taken more than once for credit in different topics with permission of the department.
title: Topics in Applied Statistics
